technical_and_design_decisions: All implementation changes will adhere to existing Spring framework coding and design conventions to maintain consistency with the broader codebase.

All upgrade-related changes will prioritize maintaining full backward compatibility with existing user code, deployment configurations, and API contracts as specified in the corresponding user stories.
The new Mesos SPI undeployed status will be added as a new enum value in the existing status enumeration, with updated mapping logic to replace the current unknown state for undeployed resources.

The Rabbit binder REST API will follow existing Spring REST controller patterns used in the project, including consistent request/response formatting, error handling, and authentication/authorization checks.
YARN deployer optimizations will leverage existing Spring YARN extension points to avoid breaking changes to existing deployment workflows and user-facing APIs.
Kafka partitioning key changes will be backward compatible, defaulting to existing round-robin partitioning behavior when no explicit key is set to avoid disrupting existing deployments.
HSQL DB limitation documentation will be added to the official Spring reference documentation, following existing formatting, style, and placement conventions for platform-specific limitations.

All target upgrade versions (SHDP 2.2.1 GA, SI 4.2.2.GA, latest Boot and Spring Cloud Build revisions) are compatible with the project's Java 17+ requirement as mandated by Spring Framework 6.0.
The Rabbit binder REST API will use the same authentication and authorization mechanisms as existing REST endpoints in the project, with no new security requirements.
YARN deployer optimizations will not require end users to modify their existing YARN cluster configurations to benefit from improved deployment performance.
The project uses a standard build tool (Maven or Gradle) that supports the required dependency version updates for all upgrade activities.
